verdict.rationale: No first-party documentation in the pack describes the model's weaknesses or failure modes. The docs cited cover capabilities and features. The weaknesses that do appear (shader struggles, non-determinism) come from community users, not the vendor. An employee's HN remark about publishing evals where OpenAI is behind is not product documentation of what the model is bad at.

support.subject: As a developer, the vendor documents the model's failure modes and jagged edges — what it is bad at, in its own docs, not just what it aces
